headlines.title: Wall Street bank backs Netflix despite U.S. drift to YouTube
headlines.summary: The bank just upgraded Netflix on a thesis that has little to do with its American viewers. The analyst also sees AI as more of a tailwind than a threat.

headlines.title: Netflix Stock Has Turned $1,000 Into About $654,000 Since Its IPO. It Has Gone Nowhere Since 2021.
headlines.summary: The streamer's stock is back where it was in late 2021. What does it take to keep compounding from here?

headlines.title: Netflix's Content Commitments Rise: Is Cash Flow Under Pressure?
headlines.summary: NFLX's rising content commitments and heavier upfront spending are squeezing cash flow as it expands its global entertainment pipeline.

headlines.title: What You Need To Know Ahead of Netflix's Earnings Release
headlines.summary: Netflix is expected to release its third-quarter earnings next month, and analysts expect a double-digit percentage rise in its bottom line.

headlines.title: Netflix, Inc. (NFLX) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) has been one of the stocks most watched by Zacks.com users lately. So, it is worth exploring what lies ahead for the stock.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
